theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 11 群

items.colloc: attend a meeting 出席會議 | attend a seminar 參加研討會
items.distinct: participate in 參與（強調互動）| join 加入（強調成為一份子）
ex: Please confirm if you can attend the meeting.
請確認您是否能出席會議。
All staff members must attend the training session.
所有員工必須參加這次培訓課程。
She attended a conference in Tokyo last week.
她上週去東京參加了一場研討會。

items.colloc: attract attention 吸引注意 | attract customers 吸引顧客
items.distinct: distract 分心；使轉移注意力 | extract 提取；選出
ex: The new marketing campaign attracted many customers.
新的行銷活動吸引了許多顧客。
Our company aims to attract top talent globally.
我們公司目標在於吸引全球頂尖人才。
High salaries help attract qualified job applicants.
高薪有助於吸引合格的求職者。

items.pos: adj. 平均的；普通的 | n. 平均值
items.colloc: above average 高於平均 | on average 平均而言
items.distinct: standard 標準的 | normal 正常的
ex: The average salary for this position is competitive.
這個職位的平均薪資很有競爭力。
On average, we process fifty orders every day.
我們平均每天處理五十筆訂單。
His performance was above the department average.
他的表現高於部門平均水準。

items.pos: n. 平衡；餘額 | v. 使平衡
items.colloc: bank balance 銀行餘額 | strike a balance 取得平衡
items.distinct: remain 剩餘物 | budget 預算
ex: Please check your current account balance online.
請在線上查詢您目前的帳戶餘額。
We must balance our work and personal lives.
我們必須平衡工作與個人生活。
The company needs to balance quality and costs.
公司需要平衡品質與成本。

items.colloc: career path 職涯路徑 | pursue a career 從事某種職業
items.distinct: job 工作（特定職務）| profession 專業職業（需執照）
ex: She has built a successful career in finance.
她在金融界建立了成功的職涯。
I am considering a change in my career path.
我正在考慮轉換職涯跑道。
Many young people seek career development opportunities.
許多年輕人尋求職涯發展機會。

items.pos: adj. 具挑戰性的；困難的
items.colloc: challenging task 挑戰性的任務 | challenging environment 艱難環境
items.distinct: difficult 困難的 | demanding 嚴格要求的
ex: This project is the most challenging one yet.
這個專案是目前最具挑戰性的一個。
He enjoys working in a challenging environment.
他喜歡在具挑戰性的環境中工作。
We faced some challenging issues during the launch.
我們在發布期間面臨了一些棘手的問題。

items.colloc: have no choice 沒有選擇 | make a choice 做決定
items.distinct: option 選項 | selection 選拔；精選
ex: We have several choices for the new office location.
我們有幾個新辦公地點的選擇。
Making the right choice is crucial for success.
做出正確的選擇對於成功至關重要。
There was a wide choice of products available.
現場有廣泛的產品選擇。

items.colloc: a combination of 結合了... | unique combination 獨特的組合
items.distinct: mixture 混合物 | collection 收藏；收集
ex: Success is a combination of hard work and luck.
成功是努力與運氣的結合。
This package is a combination of two services.
這個包裹是兩項服務的組合。
We used a unique combination of marketing strategies.
我們使用了獨特的行銷策略組合。

items.colloc: coming week 下週 | coming season 即將到來的季節
items.distinct: future 未來的 | next 下一個
ex: We are preparing for the coming busy season.
我們正在為即將到來的旺季做準備。
The coming meeting will focus on budget plans.
即將到來的會議將聚焦於預算計畫。
Updates will be released in the coming days.
更新資訊將在未來幾天內發布。

items.colloc: steering committee 指導委員會 | on a committee 隸屬於委員會
items.distinct: board 董事會 | department 部門
ex: The committee will meet to review the proposal.
委員會將開會審核這項提案。
She serves on the planning committee this year.
她今年在規劃委員會任職。
The committee reached a final decision yesterday.
委員會昨天做出了最終決定。

items.pos: adj. 相當多的；值得考慮的
items.colloc: considerable amount 相當大的數量 | considerable time 花費相當多時間
items.distinct: considerate 體貼的 | thoughtful 深思熟慮的
ex: The project required a considerable amount of time.
這個專案花費了相當多的時間。
There is considerable interest in the new product.
大眾對新產品有相當大的興趣。
He has made considerable progress in his research.
他在研究上取得了相當大的進展。

items.colloc: constant change 持續的改變 | constant demand 持續的需求
items.distinct: continuous 連續不斷的 | frequent 頻繁的
ex: We face constant changes in the market trend.
我們面對市場趨勢的持續變化。
The printer needs constant maintenance and care.
這台印表機需要持續的維護與保養。
She received constant support from her teammates.
她持續獲得隊友的支持。

items.colloc: contain information 包含資訊 | contain costs 控制成本
items.distinct: include 包含（部分）| consist of 由...組成
ex: This folder contains all the necessary documents.
這個資料夾包含所有必要的檔案。
The report contains valuable market analysis data.
這份報告包含有價值的市場分析數據。
We need to contain costs to stay profitable.
我們需要控制成本以維持獲利。

items.pos: n. 損害；賠償金 | v. 損壞
items.colloc: cause damage 造成損害 | property damage 財產損失
items.distinct: break 打破 | destroy 毀滅
ex: The storm caused severe damage to the building.
暴風雨對建築物造成了嚴重的損害。
Please report any damage to the office equipment.
請回報辦公設備的任何損壞。
Careless handling can damage the delicate parts.
粗心的搬運可能會損壞精密的零件。

items.colloc: badly damaged 嚴重受損 | damaged goods 受損商品
items.distinct: broken 破碎的 | flawed 有瑕疵的
ex: We found some damaged items in the shipment.
我們在貨運中發現了一些受損的物品。
The damaged files were recovered by the IT team.
受損的檔案已被資訊團隊修復。
They offered a discount for the damaged product.
他們針對受損產品提供了折扣。

items.pos: n. 慾望；願望 | v. 渴望
items.colloc: desire for success 對成功的渴望 | strong desire 強烈的願望
items.distinct: wish 希望 | demand 要求
ex: He has a strong desire to lead the team.
他有強烈領導團隊的渴望。
They desire to expand their business internationally.
他們渴望將業務擴展到國際。
The client expressed a desire for better service.
客戶表達了對更好服務的需求。

items.pos: n. 細節 | v. 詳細說明
items.colloc: in detail 詳細地 | pay attention to detail 注意細節
items.distinct: specifics 具體事項 | information 資訊
ex: Please explain the project plan in more detail.
請更詳細地說明專案計畫。
The contract contains all the specific details.
合約中包含了所有具體的細節。
He detailed the procedures during the briefing.
他在簡報中詳細說明了各項程序。

items.colloc: emphasize the importance of 強調...的重要性 | strongly emphasize 強烈強調
items.distinct: highlight 強調；突顯 | stress 強調（壓力）
ex: The manager emphasized the importance of teamwork.
經理強調了團隊合作的重要性。
Our company emphasizes providing excellent customer service.
我們公司強調提供卓越的客戶服務。
She emphasized that deadlines must be met.
她強調必須遵守截止日期。

items.pos: v. 使能夠；使成為可能
items.colloc: enable someone to do something 使某人能夠做某事 | enable access 允許存取
items.distinct: allow 允許 | permit 許可
ex: New software will enable us to work faster.
新軟體將使我們工作得更快。
This feature enables users to track their progress.
此功能讓使用者能追蹤他們的進度。
The loan will enable the company to expand.
這筆貸款將使公司能夠擴張業務。

items.colloc: the entire day 一整天 | the entire staff 全體員工
items.distinct: whole 全部的 | complete 完整的
ex: The entire project was completed ahead of schedule.
整個專案提前完成了。
He spent the entire day reviewing the documents.
他花了一整天審核這些文件。
The entire staff was invited to the party.
全體員工都受邀參加宴會。
